static_traits.name: Chen Shaoyu

static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友可交流，但尚not yet与任何人讨论该具体问题

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己现在就应该是Business owner，但却只是本地杂货店的经理，这一想法带来not满与自卑感。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not满与比较的感受正在影响我的心理健康和整体幸福感。
growth_experiences: 大约一年前开始将自己的职业进展与个人Anticipation进行比较，逐渐产生not满与自卑感；当not yet能按Anticipation快速达成目标时压力显著升高；问题在Work变得更为繁忙或具有挑战的日子尤为持续；尝试通过设定更高目标并在Work中更努力来证明自身价值，但压力反而加剧。

core_beliefs: 只有成为Business owner才算成功、有价值

special_situations.event: Sees success stories of entrepreneurs of the same age or younger
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在18岁还not是Business owner，就说明我失败、落后于他人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets higher goals and pushes harder at work to prove his own worth

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能快速达成职业目标，就说明我without能或not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works overtime, pressures himself, raises goals in hopes of achieving faster

special_situations.event: Reviews the gap between career expectations at age 18 and reality
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must reach goals on the set timetable to count as success, otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我施压、not断提高Demands、忽略当前角色的积极面
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should be the boss by now

special_situations.event: Becomes aware of his 'manager' identity when interacting with colleagues or leading a team
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not是老板，do not人会看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免谈及自我not安感、not与朋友讨论具体困扰
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们可能觉得我not值得尊重

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过尽快成为Business owner来Gaining recognition与价值感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为失败者、被比较为not如人、因此被贬低
defense_goal: 通过设定更高目标与加倍努力来控制Anxiety、维护自我价值
避免向朋友透露not安以减少被评判的风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、落后于他人的追赶者
object_relations.object_representation: Others (especially successful peers/colleagues) are internalized as judges and embodiments of strict standards

manifestations: 当前经理角色被Self-deprecation为“not够”、“只是经理”，与理想（成为Business owner）之间的落差被视为失败
持续的自我比较与“应该”语句Reinforcement对自我价值的条件化认定
outcomes: Maintaining relationships with colleagues becomes more challenging

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁use“我应该……”等自我苛责语句
Sets excessively high goals and pressures himself to prove his worth
Excessively concerned about whether self meets standards when interacting with others

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not yet与朋友讨论具体困扰，将压力与not安向内承受
通过更努力Work而非寻求外界支持来处理自我价值Anxiety
